pregnancy.summaryPeriod: During period days, pregnancy probability is generally very low.
pregnancy.summaryHigh: This day is very close to ovulation, so probability is highest.
pregnancy.summaryMedium: You are within the fertile window, with moderate pregnancy probability.

pregnancy.recommendHighConceive: If trying to conceive, this is one of your best timing days.

pregnancy.recommendMediumConceive: Plan intercourse around this window and keep lifestyle habits consistent.
pregnancy.recommendMediumAvoid: Consider backup protection during fertile-window days.

mentalHealth.title: Mental health exercises
mentalHealth.subtitle: Cycle-aware routines for stress, sleep, and emotional balance.
mentalHealth.safetyNote: Lunella support is educational and not a replacement for professional care. If you feel unsafe or overwhelmed, seek urgent help.
mentalHealth.safetyMessage: If you are in emotional crisis or feel unsafe, contact local emergency services immediately. In the U.S. call or text 988 for the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
mentalHealth.moodBeforeLabel: How do you feel before this exercise?
mentalHealth.moodAfterLabel: How do you feel after this exercise?
mentalHealth.savedMessage: Great work. Your progress has been added to your wellness insights.
mentalHealth.ratingRequiredMessage: Please select both before and after mood ratings.
mentalHealth.programCalmDescription: A short anti-anxiety flow combining breath pacing and sensory grounding.
mentalHealth.programLutealDescription: Reframing and nervous-system settling for pre-period emotional intensity.
mentalHealth.programSleepDescription: Body scan and gentle journaling to reduce tension before sleep.
mentalHealth.sessionCalmBreathPrompt: Use an even rhythm to stabilize heart rate and quiet racing thoughts.
mentalHealth.sessionGroundingPrompt: Anchor attention in the present when your thoughts are spinning.
mentalHealth.sessionReframePrompt: Catch one heavy thought and replace it with a more balanced statement.
mentalHealth.sessionSlowBreathPrompt: Longer exhales reduce body tension and emotional reactivity.
mentalHealth.sessionBodyScanPrompt: Release stored tension from head to toe before bedtime.
mentalHealth.sessionReleasePrompt: Unload mental noise so your brain can switch into rest mode.
mentalHealth.journalPromptCalm: What helped your body feel safer in this moment?
mentalHealth.journalPromptGrounding: What detail brought you back to the present?
mentalHealth.journalPromptReframe: What is a kinder replacement thought you can repeat tonight?
mentalHealth.journalPromptLuteal: What boundary or need deserves attention today?
mentalHealth.journalPromptSleep: Which body area softened the most during this practice?
mentalHealth.journalPromptRelease: Write 1 thing to release and 1 thing to carry into tomorrow.
mentalHealth.stepBoxBreathing1: Inhale through your nose for 4 counts.
mentalHealth.stepBoxBreathing3: Exhale slowly for 4 counts and repeat.
mentalHealth.stepGrounding1: Name 5 things you can see around you.
mentalHealth.stepGrounding2: Name 4 things you can physically feel.
mentalHealth.stepReframe1: Write one stressful thought exactly as it appears.
mentalHealth.stepReframe2: Ask: What evidence supports and challenges this thought?
mentalHealth.stepReframe3: Rewrite it as a fair, compassionate statement.
mentalHealth.stepBodyScan1: Relax your forehead, jaw, and neck.
mentalHealth.stepBodyScan2: Soften chest, belly, and hands with each exhale.
mentalHealth.stepBodyScan3: Release hips, legs, and feet into the surface.
mentalHealth.stepRelease1: Write down what is mentally heavy right now.
mentalHealth.stepRelease2: Circle what is outside your control for tonight.
mentalHealth.stepRelease3: Set one small intention for tomorrow morning.

ai.heroSubtitle: Personalized support for timing, symptoms, and daily guidance.
ai.welcomeMessage: Hi! I am your cycle AI assistant. Ask me about your next period, ovulation, fertility window, or symptom care.
ai.prompt3: How can I reduce period cramps?
ai.replyOvulation: Your next predicted ovulation is on {{ovulationDate}}. The fertile window is {{fertilityWindow}}. Try symptom logging each morning for better timing.
ai.replyFertility: Your predicted fertility window is {{fertilityWindow}}. For trying to conceive, focus on sleep, hydration, and symptom notes during this phase.
ai.replyPeriod: Based on your {{cycleLength}}-day cycle, your next period is expected around {{nextPeriodDate}} ({{daysLeft}} days left). If your pattern changes for 2-3 cycles, update your cycle length in profile.
ai.replyCramp: For cramp days: warm ginger tea, gentle stretching, magnesium-rich foods, and hydration can help. If pain is severe or disruptive, reach out to a clinician.
ai.replyMood: Try the breathing exercise in Tips for 4 rounds, then do a 10-minute walk. Mood shifts are common around cycle changes; sleep and hydration make a big difference.
ai.replySummary: Quick plan: cycle length {{cycleLength}} days, period length {{periodLength}} days, next period {{nextPeriodDate}}, ovulation {{ovulationDate}}, fertility window {{fertilityWindow}}. Your selected goals: {{goals}}.
ai.replyDefault: Here is your current cycle snapshot: next period {{nextPeriodDate}}, ovulation {{ovulationDate}}, fertility window {{fertilityWindow}}. Ask me about period timing, symptoms, food tips, or fertility guidance.
ai.fallbackNotice: Live AI is temporarily unavailable. Here is your offline guidance:
ai.connectionError: I'm having trouble connecting to live AI right now. Please try again in a moment.
